title: Start a task and wait for it
objective: Start work with start a task, and wait for all started tasks with wait for all tasks before going on.

body.text: A task is work that runs at the same time as the rest of your program. Write start a task, then indent the lines that belong to it. The program does not wait for the task to finish before it moves on, so use wait for all tasks when a later line needs the task's work done first.

body.title: Wait for a task before continuing
body.code:
start a task
    say "one"
wait for all tasks
say "done"
